# Extract month from date column and filter for losses
df['month'] = df['date'].str.extract(r'^([a-z]+)', expand=False)
losses_by_month = df[df['result'] == 'loss'].groupby('month').size()

# Check conditions
sept_losses = losses_by_month.get('sept', 0) == 1
nov_losses = losses_by_month.get('nov', 0) == 2

answer = sept_losses and nov_losses
